en.p: For two constants $a$, $b\ (1<a<b)$, the $y$-intercept of the line through the two points $(a,\,\log_2 a)$, $(b,\,\log_2 b)$ in the coordinate plane equals the $y$-intercept of the line through the two points $(a,\,\log_4 a)$, $(b,\,\log_4 b)$. For the function $f(x)=a^{bx}+b^{ax}$, when $f(1)=40$, what is the value of $f(2)$? [4 points]
